title: 1.1 Definition of Biology
description: Definition of biology and its relation to other sciences

questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'biology'?
options: They prevent other plants from growing
It showed that all cells are identical
Regrowth after an abandoned farm field
The study of life and living organisms
questions.correctAnswer: The study of life and living organisms

questions.question: The word biology is derived from which two Greek words?
What does the Greek word 'bios' mean?
What does the Greek word 'logos' mean?
Which of the following is a similarity between biology and chemistry?
options: Both involve the study of matter and its transformations
A lower temperature is needed for viable sperm formation
Making the body defend against disease-causing organisms
He was observing the empty cell walls of dead cork cells
questions.correctAnswer: Both involve the study of matter and its transformations

questions.question: The formation of oxyhaemoglobin during transport of oxygen is explained by which science?
The absorption of water from root to leaves involves cohesion and adhesion, which are concepts explained by which science?
All metabolic pathways in living organisms involve chemical change, showing that biology is closely related to which science?
Diffusion and osmosis are processes in living organisms that are explained by which science?
Why is the study of biology important in medicine?
options: Wash the wound and apply a bandage from the first aid kit
It helps understand the causes and treatments of diseases
A solution with the same solute concentration as the cell
Plants that receive twice the normal amount of fertilizer
questions.correctAnswer: It helps understand the causes and treatments of diseases

questions.question: How is biology applied in the field of agriculture?
options: Lipid and steroid synthesis, detoxification, and calcium storage
Divide the objective magnification by the eyepiece magnification
By improving crop yields and developing disease-resistant plants
All follicles in the ovaries have been released or disintegrated
questions.correctAnswer: By improving crop yields and developing disease-resistant plants

questions.question: Biology is applied in forensics for what purpose?
options: By carrying it with two hands on the base
They require no cooperation from partners
Two separate eggs fertilized by two sperm

questions.question: How does biology contribute to environmental conservation?
options: A testable explanation or prediction for an observation
By understanding ecosystems and protecting biodiversity
Primary starts without soil; secondary starts with soil
Fermented foods like injera and their nutritional value
questions.correctAnswer: By understanding ecosystems and protecting biodiversity

questions.question: What is the electron transport chain involved in?
options: To provide a baseline for comparison

questions.question: The structure of the cell membrane involves lipids and proteins and is explained by which science?
Capillary action and surface tension help explain water movement in plants. These are concepts from which science?
What is the relationship between biology and physics called when studying biophysical processes?
What do we call the application of biological knowledge to solve crimes?
Which field uses biology to develop new drugs and vaccines?
How does biology help in the production of food?
options: producer → primary consumer → secondary consumer → tertiary consumer
Excretion removes undigested food, egestion removes metabolic wastes
Egestion removes undigested food, excretion removes metabolic wastes
By developing better crop varieties and improving livestock breeding

questions.question: The absorption and elimination of salts in the excretory system involves acid-base equilibrium to maintain $pH$. This is a concept from which science?
Biology contributes to conservation biology by helping to do what?
options: Protect endangered species and their habitats
Thickening the uterine lining after ovulation
Gastritis, peptic ulcer, and loss of appetite
Carry them with both hands and walk carefully

questions.question: What is the study of tissues called when discussing biology's relationship with other sciences?
Which branch of science involves the study of the chemical reactions that take place in living organisms?
Biology is related to physics through concepts such as?
options: Swelling of the legs and abdomen, dry or flaky skin, and changes in hair colour
By features such as body structure, number of limbs, and method of reproduction
It requires energy (ATP) to move substances against their concentration gradient
Light refraction in the eye, leverage in bones, and fluid dynamics in blood flow
questions.correctAnswer: Light refraction in the eye, leverage in bones, and fluid dynamics in blood flow

questions.question: Why is biology important in the field of biotechnology?
options: It helps produce antibiotics, enzymes, and genetically modified organisms
The same common name can refer to different species in different regions
To smother small fires or wrap around a person whose clothing is on fire
A researcher or scientist who studies nutrition and its effects on health
questions.correctAnswer: It helps produce antibiotics, enzymes, and genetically modified organisms

questions.question: DNA analysis, a biological tool, is used in paternity testing to do what?
options: Permanent, though sometimes reversible by microsurgery
The movement of water across a semi-permeable membrane
It breaks into parts that develop into whole organisms

questions.question: What does the study of biology help us understand about the human body?
options: To provide a medium for chemical reactions and support for organelles
In the nucleoid region (a region of the cytoplasm without a membrane)
How organs function, how diseases develop, and how to maintain health
A phospholipid bilayer with embedded proteins that can move laterally
questions.correctAnswer: How organs function, how diseases develop, and how to maintain health

questions.question: The study of ecology, a branch of biology, helps us understand what?
options: How organisms interact with each other and with their environment
All cells are identical, cells need energy, cells have cell walls
organism → population → ecosystem → community → biome → biosphere
Green chloroplasts moving around the cell (cytoplasmic streaming)
questions.correctAnswer: How organisms interact with each other and with their environment
